company.name: AVIA Distribution SA

company.name: Koscher City (Bloch-Erlanger AG)
company.channel: Kosher food distributors
company.distributes: Kosher groceries with a confectionery and bakery goods department: sweets, lollipops, marshmallows and kosher Haribo gummies, plus wine, dairy, meat and fish
company.channels_supplied: Its own Koscher City supermarket in Zurich; its operator Bloch-Erlanger AG, a family importer and wholesaler in Schubelbach, supplies Coop stores directly with Coop's kosher range

Bloch-Erlanger has traded since 1990 and Koscher City claims the largest kosher range in Switzerland.
company.fit_rationale: Koscher City calls itself the largest kosher food shop in Switzerland and its website lists a confectionery department, while press reports name imported US and Canadian sweets and kosher Haribo on its shelves. Its operator Bloch-Erlanger imports kosher goods and runs Coop's kosher range, so one contact reaches both the main kosher shop and the national chain's kosher shelf. Storage: sells from its own stock in the Zurich supermarket; Bloch-Erlanger is listed as a food wholesaler in Schubelbach, warehouse not named on its website.
